The pre-1971 period is a low-confidence association-history backcast; extraordinary 2006 per-capita participation supports strong modern popularity without implying elite strength. The 1–10 value is project-authored and does not convert missing professional evidence into zero.

squash_access.rationale: FIFA Earth Oceania estimate for COK. Very high per-capita registration and club density support high access, moderated slightly by archipelagic logistics documented in the current association network. The 1–10 value is project-authored and does not convert missing professional evidence into zero.

development_quality.rationale: FIFA Earth Oceania estimate for COK. Association/FIFA structure creates a pathway, but tiny scale and sparse direct development evidence keep quality modest despite excellent participation access. The 1–10 value is project-authored and does not convert missing professional evidence into zero.

competition_quality.rationale: FIFA Earth Oceania estimate for COK. CIFA/FIFA organisation supports formal competition, but small population and missing professional-report values prevent access density from being misread as competition depth. The 1–10 value is project-authored and does not convert missing professional evidence into zero.

elite_support.rationale: FIFA Earth Oceania estimate for COK. Formal association and FIFA membership support basic elite administration, while no professional ecosystem evidence justifies a high support score. The 1–10 value is project-authored and does not convert missing professional evidence into zero.

squash_tradition.rationale: FIFA Earth Oceania estimate for COK. The 1955–1970 period is an explicit low-confidence pre-CIFA backcast; tradition rises after the 1971 association foundation and 1994 FIFA membership. The 1–10 value is project-authored and does not convert missing professional evidence into zero.
